translation_notes: `rdflib.URIRef(uri) not in rdf.subjects()` -> `not bool(m{ {rdflib.URIRef(uri)} ?p ?o }(rdf))`: subject bound, predicate/object wildcards -- the direct trav_existence idiom for 'is this term ever a subject', more direct than materialising all subjects to test membership.

the force=False + uri-not-a-subject branch RAISES ValueError; the harness compares two raises by type and message, and driver.py exercises it (absent, object-only and predicate-only URIs). The force=True branch's warning is made a compared outcome by turning UserWarning into an error in the driver.

fixture.ttl covers a subject with two triples (several solutions), a URI that appears only as an OBJECT (neighbourhood: must not count as a subject), and a URI absent altogether (zero-solution, exercised via a driver case rather than the fixture alone).

repair.driver: UserWarning transforme en erreur pour tout le pilote (l'avertissement de force=True devient une issue comparee, type et message) ; appels ajoutes : URI absent, seulement objet et seulement predicat (ex:p) avec force=False (levee ValueError comparee), URI present passe en URIRef, et deux sujets ex:other et ex:onlyQ (nouveau voisin `ex:onlyQ ex:q ex:somewhere` dans la fixture) qui tuent un ?p ou un ?o resserre. Les trois appels d'origine sont gardes.
